title: Cover the remaining unconfirmed-root reason branches end to end
outcome: Every Unconfirmed exit of the explained root and turn captures is reached through the capture function in a test, or is documented as unreachable in practice. That includes the claim-journal reasons (JournalPending, JournalReconciliationUnsettled, JournalRetired), the turn-level opening-store work-unresolved exit, and the retired-journal fallthrough that returns the opening provenance. The reason sentences for BoundRootMismatch (which also covers a non-positive generation) and NamedRootUnknown (which asserts a cause the check does not test) describe exactly what is checked.
acceptance: Cover the remaining unconfirmed-root reason branches end to end is done
